test_title: PYST 46 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-number cluster in the same way as the second letter-number cluster is related to the first letter-number cluster and sixth letter-number cluster is related to fifth letter-number cluster.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

GW100 : JR150 : : FB160 : ? : : PS200 : SN300
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b74e0be9d37ca7906c360da235a17f2139b1d9a84f00377d8b631e634dd782f.png] 

**Given: **GW100 : JR150 : : FB160 : ? : : PS200 : SN300

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e904c87714cd3ae6ede09d37b0e42f7c9f9904fcde8c8a89a67ab4a215b61a81.png] 

100 + (100 ÷ 2) = 100 + 50 = 150

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87a1695cb7aa211207b0926eec91b5651506c2e699f7dd0331f421519f2ff929.png] 

200 + (200 ÷ 2) = 200 + 100 = 300

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e345e6e2768912c2b557c0a84cabfd2e28c9dd76641d42f3080dde3afa6492c.png] 

160 + (160 ÷ 2) = 160 + 80 = 240

Thus, IW240 is related to FB160.
Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**"
